question: Should this PR require a real Apple Watch or diagnostic WatchConnectivity proof run before merge, or may maintainers explicitly accept the current source/CI proof for this hardware-limited path?
rationale: The diff changes user-visible Watch delivery plus durable message/session state, and the PR body explicitly says no physical Apple Watch round-trip was available.

options.title: Require Watch delivery proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Apple Watch or WatchConnectivity log/recording/artifact showing a queued quick reply surviving reconnect or restart before merge.

options.title: Accept maintainer proof override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the hardware proof gap after reviewing the source, focused tests, and exact-head CI results.

options.title: Fold into broader mobile outbox work
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer the Watch reply fix to land only as part of the broader offline command outbox direction.

recommendation.title: Require Watch delivery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Apple Watch or WatchConnectivity log/recording/artifact showing a queued quick reply surviving reconnect or restart before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened the maintainer-labeled replacement branch and has the strongest recent iOS/watch ownership signal.
